# FLX-3617: a consumers calibration parameter names a document outside the bundle's closed set

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

calibration.parameters[].document names one of the files that make up the bundle: a top-level *.flux.yml, *.flux.yaml, *.fluid.yml or *.fluid.yaml file of the bundle directory, the closed set of files inputDigest covers (ADR 0006). A path, a file from another directory or a file the loader does not read is refused, since the overlay a fit writes may only change the bundle's own documents.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3617
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
